svg.text: INFEASIBLE: negative float, shortfall in WD (never compressed)
ask by: last day to decide whether to raise a clarification request
OVERLOAD: role over capacity that day

PROPOSAL, not reviewed. Timing, decision readiness and resource feasibility are separate statuses; resource levelling is NOT implemented; overloads are reported, not resolved. No bidder references, certificates, attendance or financial standing are assumed to exist.

Each row: activity id, count, then the A1 requirement ids that fit (+n more); ALL ids are in the row's hover title, gantt.html and programme.csv. Load window: late (LS..LF, clipped at the planning date).

Milestones outside the chart: Reference look-back start 2016-11-27 (conservative; 2016-11-26 if the boundary day counts); Blackout start 2026-09-14; Pre-Bid Conference 10:00 2026-09-30; Site visit (optional) 2026-10-01; Attendance-notice window ends (conditional) 2026-10-14 (conservative; 2026-10-15 if the ADD-01 issue day is excluded); Proposal validity end 2027-04-25 (conservative; 2027-04-24 if the PDD
counts as day 1); Bid bond validity end 2027-05-25 (conservative; 2027-05-24 if the PDD counts as day 1).

REVIEW (<status> ...) tags: Relationship status: confirmed = stated in the documents (the entry quotes the cross-reference), not confirmed by a person; proposed = inferred by a curator or a model, a person decides; possible = a weaker inference.
